top_signals.title: South Africa Taps Gulf Know-How for $9.5 Billion Property Plan
top_signals.summary: Middle East sovereign wealth funds, backed by trillions of dollars in assets, have advised South Africa to create a fundraising vehicle as part of a plan for a new state firm that will manage its 155 billion-rand ($9.5 billion) property portfolio.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: China’s Coking Coal Supply Squeeze Seen Lingering Into 2027
top_signals.summary: China’s coking coal squeeze is set to persist into next year, supporting strong import demand even as efforts to revive domestic output start to cool prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Gasoline, Distillate Inventories Continue to Fall as Crude Stocks Hold
top_signals.summary: The American Petroleum Institute (API) estimated that crude oil inventories in the United States rose by 1.786 million barrels in the week ending September 18. In the week prior, US crude oil inventories grew by a substantial 7.14 million barrels. Commercial crude oil inventories excluding the SPR have lost 39 million barrels over the last 23 weeks, but US crude inventories are up nearly 12 million for the year, according to API data, kept in check by draws from the SPR. top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Republican senator calls for probe into US presidents’ sons, citing crypto ventures
top_signals.summary: Many Democrats have previously called for investigations into the Trump family’s crypto ventures, but now a Republican is asking for an inquiry based on ties to the presidency.

top_signals.title: CFTC Chairman Selig says markets must prepare for ‘mass tokenization’
top_signals.summary: The Trump administration is preparing for a financial market overhaul as tokenization  and 24/7 trading move into the spotlight.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
